# Attribution

`fno_dual/ffno.py` follows the [FourierFlow](https://github.com/alasdairtran/fourierflow) `FNOFactorized2DBlock` architecture (factorized one-dimensional Fourier branches, backcast feed-forward blocks and residual stacking), as documented in the source. The local FourierFlow distribution's MIT notice is preserved in `FourierFlow-LICENSE`. FourierFlow is not required as an installed dependency for these experiments.

See the manuscript bibliography for the Factorized Fourier Neural Operators paper and the research context of the other baselines. The Equation-Recast-style dynamic-step adapter here is not the official authors' implementation.
